headline: GOING LAST
IS A
SUPERPOWER.

scenes.say: At the poker table, going last is a superpower. Most players don't even notice.
The player who acts first decides in the dark.
The player who acts last sees what everyone did, then chooses.
Information is edge. Position controls the pot and gives you more options every street.
Same in negotiations: whoever names a price second knows more.
When you can, let the other side show their cards first.

takeaway: When you can, let the other side show their cards first.
